title: Easy Silky Malaysian Chicken Noodles
description: A kid-friendly Malaysian dish featuring dashi and temper, this recipe is onion and garlic free, making it perfect for those with dietary restrictions, and has a tangy and silky texture.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the noodles according to the package instructions.
In a large bowl, whisk together the dashi powder and 2 cups of water to make the dashi broth.
In a large pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and add the chicken breast, cooking until browned and cooked through.
Add the soy sauce, coconut milk, and fish balls to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the dashi broth to the pan and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let cook for 5 minutes.
Add the cooked noodles to the pan and stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
